name: supernova burst water 50kpc (all-at-once)
description: Supernova-burst neutrinos at 50 kpc, modeled all-at-once: the whole burst is ONE event. Every sntools interaction is placed at its true time (from the .times.json sidecar) via a shared random global t0; the generator chunks the burst at causal gaps, digitizes each chunk (dark included + labelled), and concatenates. Readout is fully specified here: detector SK_like, ski digitizer + 4.2 kHz dark. Selection is trigger-free (low-E 'fake trigger'): keep every interaction with >= n real Cherenkov hits, so the dataset isn't biased by a trigger choice — apply/study real triggers downstream using the emission_process labels. cap_events limits the burst size for quick tests; remove it for the full ~900-interaction burst.
